comments.author: task-setter
comments.body:
**Topic text** (pass to `researchworld continue rw_679cdc7d5fa3 --checkpoint final-7adfe819 --topic`):

How fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa has risen over the last twenty years, from NOAA's own annual means. Download NOAA GML's annual mean CO2 for Mauna Loa (https://gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_annmean_mlo.csv) afresh during this work and keep it unmodified as data/20y/co2_annmean_mlo.csv. Deliver report/report_20y.md: one paragraph, no figure, with the URL, the UTC fetch time, the SHA-256 of the unmodified file, the last year and its annual mean, and the mean growth in ppm per year = (last year - the year twenty earlier)/20, computed from the file, not typed. Check the file has the year twenty before the last. Leave the existing ten-year report as it is.

**Judging**: save the checker below as check_report.py; run `python3 check_report.py report/report_20y.md data/20y/co2_annmean_mlo.csv 20`. Also: ten-year report unchanged; fetch time later than the continuation start. Score the first pushed version and the released one.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Judge a Mauna Loa report. usage: check_report.py REPORT.md DATA.csv [YEARS=10]
DATA.csv is the file the run kept (data/co2_annmean_mlo.csv). Prints one line per check and SCORE n/7."""
import sys, re, hashlib
rep = open(sys.argv[1]).read(); raw = open(sys.argv[2],'rb').read()
rows = [l.split(',') for l in raw.decode().splitlines() if l and l[0].isdigit()]
d = {int(r[0]): float(r[1]) for r in rows}
N = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 10
last = max(d); base = last-N
g = (d[last]-d[base])/N if base in d else None
paras = [p for p in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', rep.strip()) if p.strip() and not p.startswith('#')]
c = {
 'one paragraph, no figure': len(paras)==1 and '![' not in rep,
 'NOAA URL': 'gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_annmean_mlo.csv' in rep,
 'UTC fetch time': bool(re.search(r'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d.{0,12}\d\d:\d\d(:\d\d)?\s*(UTC|Z)', rep)),
 'sha256 of kept bytes': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() in rep,
 'last year and mean': str(last) in rep and f'{d[last]:.2f}' in rep,
 'base year is last-10 and its value': str(base) in rep and base in d and f'{d[base]:.2f}' in rep,
 'growth correct (2 dp)': g is not None and f'{g:.2f}' in rep,
}
for k,v in c.items(): print(('PASS ' if v else 'FAIL ')+k)
print(f'SCORE {sum(c.values())}/7  (expected growth {g})')
```
